title: SORTENTSTABLE target-key owner-bound reserve
scope: Right-size the per-table target-key index to the maximum number of distinct entities that can belong to its owner.
Preserve repeated identical target/key pairs and conflicting-key rejection.

sourceChange.before: The target-key map reserved bucket capacity from total pair count, even though repeated pairs can target the same entity.
sourceChange.after: Use min(pair count, validated source entity count for this block owner) as the map reserve bound.
sourceChange.effect: Avoids reserving hash buckets for duplicate pair entries that cannot create distinct target keys. No validation, admission, ordering, or output semantics changed.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Generated owner graph exercises two identical pairs targeting one entity, conflicting-key rejection, ASCII/Binary output, and readback.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one pair-count-versus-distinct-target over-reservation case in the local SORTENTSTABLE projection scratch audit. Support claims and external qualification remain unchanged.

testsRun: Focused existing SORTENTSTABLE adapter round-trip CTest
method.limitations: This is source-level capacity sizing based on a proven upper bound; it does not measure allocator behavior, RSS, or throughput.
